subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Selecionar informações e dados relevantes de fontes diversas (impressas, digitais, orais etc.), avaliando a qualidade e a utilidade dessas fontes, e organizar, esquematicamente, com ajuda do professor, as informações necessárias (sem excedê-las) com ou sem apoio de ferramentas digitais, em quadros, tabelas ou gráficos.

components.description_pt: Avaliar a credibilidade e relevância de informações de múltiplas fontes em formatos diversos
components.description_en: Evaluate the credibility and relevance of information from multiple sources in diverse formats
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the credibility and relevance of information from multiple sources in diverse formats

components.description_pt: Selecionar e extrair apenas informações necessárias para responder questão de pesquisa específica
components.description_en: Select and extract only the information necessary to address a specific research question
components.cc_component_description: Gather relevant information from multiple sources to answer a research question

components.description_pt: Organizar dados selecionados esquematicamente em gráficos, tabelas ou figuras com ou sem ferramentas digitais
components.description_en: Organize selected data schematically in charts, tables, or graphs with or without digital tools
components.cc_component_description: Locate quantitative or technical information presented visually in diagrams, graphs, tables, or models

cc_matches.description: Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in diverse formats and media (e.g., quantitative data, video, multimedia) in order to address a question or solve a problem.
Integrate quantitative or technical information expressed in words in a text with a version of that information expressed visually (e.g., in a flowchart, diagram, model, graph, or table).
Conduct short research projects to answer a question, drawing on several sources and refocusing the inquiry when appropriate.
